findings.issue: Directly readable IOP journal policy confirms no subscription publication, submission or other publishing charges. IOP AI policy expressly permits research, analysis/code and critically revised generated text with disclosure.
findings.resolution: Retained verified-free route and compatible AI classification. The metrics link did not yield a verified numerical figure.

findings.issue: Elsevier journal-specific fees and AI policy were inaccessible, and the publisher notes journal-specific AI variation. Author location eligibility is not affirmed.
findings.resolution: Retained needs_verification fees and unclear AI classification; publisher metric is included as undated.

notes: Eight discovery candidates and no baseline memberships; audited all eight against completed fees, geography, and AI policy. RSC official indexed content is weaker than directly readable policy; six verified-free fee claims were demoted. IOP policy read directly and supports the stated compatible classification. Elsevier remains unclear pending journal-specific terms. Journal-level impact factors do not predict manuscript acceptance. No official acceptance rates were established.
